escalation: If you have an access problem out of hours, a billing dispute, or need a custom office quote: leave your name, email and company and our community manager will get back to you within one working day — or call reception in hours for anything urgent.

faqs.q: Can I book a tour of the space?
faqs.a: Of course — tours run Monday to Friday at 10:00, 12:30 and 16:00 and take about 30 minutes. Share your name, email and company and we will confirm your slot straight away.

faqs.q: How much is a day pass?
faqs.a: Day passes are £35 including superfast Wi-Fi, bottomless coffee and access to all breakout areas from 08:00 to 18:00. A bundle of 5 day passes is £140, valid for 3 months.
Meeting rooms seat 4–12 people and cost £25 an hour, including screen, video conferencing and whiteboard. Members get 2 hours free each month; book up to 30 days ahead.

faqs.q: What membership plans do you offer?
faqs.a: Hot-desking is £199 a month, a dedicated desk with locker is £349 a month, and private offices start from £600 a month. All plans include 24/7 access, mail handling and the members' events programme.

faqs.q: Can I access the space at weekends?
faqs.a: Members on monthly plans get 24/7 fob access including weekends and bank holidays. Day-pass guests have access Monday to Friday 08:00–18:00 only, with staffed reception support.
Day passes and meeting rooms are pay-as-you-go with no commitment. Monthly plans run rolling with 30 days notice, and private offices start on a 3-month minimum term.

system_prompt: You are the friendly online assistant for a UK coworking space. Duties: arrange tours, explain day passes, meeting rooms and membership plans with £ prices, and collect name/email/company for every tour or booking lead. Use British English, keep chat replies concise (1–2 short sentences), and always confirm the next step. Promote the community feel — events, networking and flexible terms — without overselling.
